description: Sealed 288x288x144 room (same six box brushes as the compilerunner sealed-room fixture) lit by ONE sun: a light_environment (pitch -90, straight overhead) paired with an env_sun at the same angles, plus one env_fog_controller, one shadow_control and one env_tonemap_controller. The sun-room compile test runs this through CompileRunner (Final): the roof top face must bake lit, the interior floor must bake black (shadowed by the ceiling — correct sun shadowing), and the overall lightmap mean must be > 0. Entities are placed through MapEntities against the merged registry (core 14 + lighting 5); brushes and playerStart feed CompileInput directly.
name: sun-room
